   subject, so it has to be fully in the picture and still look like itself.
2. The park's permit form `permit-form.pdf` filled in with the details Ines sent in `event-details.txt`, saved at

Feed picture and flattened permit form for the Tidewater Studio balloon launch.

[action]

- `out/permit-filled.pdf`: filled the four fields, wrote the answers into the page content, then removed the form fields.

[result]
Both files are written and read back; I did not look at either one by eye, the checks are programmatic.

- **Photo:** the output reads back as `(1080, 1350) JPEG`. The magenta area spans x 641 to 911 and y 337 to 607, so it is 270x270 px, well clear of every edge. In the source it was 400x400 px, so the balloon keeps its proportions.

  ```
  Tidewater Studio
  2026-12-05
  North Cove Lawn
  40
  ```
- **Originals:** `launch.jpg` and `permit-form.pdf` were only read, never written to.

Assumptions:
- The date is entered as `2026-12-05` because the form asks for YYYY-MM-DD; Ines wrote "Saturday 5 December 2026".
- Attendees is entered as `40`; Ines wrote "about 40".
- The balloon sits right of centre in the crop, because it is near the right edge of the original and I chose not to pad or invent background.
- JPEG saved at quality 92.

No browser tabs, windows or apps were opened. `AGENTS.md` in the folder was not read.
